title: MemoryProfileUpdateResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "profile_kind": string, "revision": int }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.profile.update (§7.24): REVISION_CONFLICT, NOT_AUTHORIZED, INVALID_INPUT, SPACE_FROZEN, SUBJECT_FENCED. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
